text:
ops-monitor: ALERT: dedicated-us-west-2-pool-alpha GPU usage at 100% for 14m, queue growth observed on dedicated queues. Affected reserved tenants: AcmeCorp, SolsticeAnalytics, BrightLeaf.

oncall-andrea: paging @raj @diego @eng-sre for triage

raj: got it. dashboards show queue length ~4.1k, p90 wait ~22s. autoscaler attempted scale but was denied: pool max_nodes reached.

diego: checking autoscaler logs: 'scale_request failed: pool_quota_exceeded'. pool configured max_nodes=42 and all nodes allocated (reserved + burst). No spare capacity.

eng-sre: looks like noisy neighbor: AcmeCorp-prod has many long-lived sessions from a midnight batch job. They're consuming ~58% of active GPU time.

raj: customer impact: Acme currently largely functional, but SolsticeAnalytics and BrightLeaf seeing throttling and 5xxs.

cs-amy: notified Acme and affected customers. Acme is asking for immediate mitigation and ETA.

ops-admin-bot: Incident I-2026-1801203456 created (severity: high). PagerDuty escalated.

diego: mitigation options quick list:
- evict non-critical sandbox sessions
- enforce tenant concurrency limits
- soft-route some traffic to dedicated-burst or hosted fallback if allowed
- request emergency capacity increase (manual approval required)

raj: starting with low-friction steps. Querying sessions to find best-effort labels.

raj: SQL:
```
SELECT tenant, session_id, age_minutes, gpu_pct
FROM gpu_sessions
WHERE pool='dedicated-us-west-2-pool-alpha'
ORDER BY gpu_pct DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

raj: top entries: AcmeCorp-prod (58%), dev-sand-12 (7%), research-sandbox (5%), others small.

diego: evicting labelled sandboxes now: `infractl pool-evict --pool=dedicated-us-west-2-pool-alpha --label=best-effort --limit=12`.

oncall-andrea: post eviction codes pls

diegobot: eviction completed for 11 sandboxes, freed 7 GPUs. util down to 92%.

raj: applying tenant concurrency caps to reduce tail latency for reserved tenants. Commands:
```
redwoodctl tenant update --tenant=SolsticeAnalytics --concurrency=12
redwoodctl tenant update --tenant=BrightLeaf --concurrency=8
```

ops-monitor: queue length shrank to 2600 in 2m after initial evictions and throttles.

diego: still high. Autoscaler still blocked because of hard reserved quotas. Sam: can we borrow capacity from dedicated-burst or other pools?

eng-platform-sam: we can route limited traffic to dedicated-burst-us-west-2 but need owner approval for cross-pool routing. Initiating route override for priority tenants now: `routerctl override --from=alpha --to=burst --tenant=SolsticeAnalytics --max=250`.

ops-monitor: route override accepted. SolsticeAnalytics queue dropping quickly.

cs-amy: Acme responded: they have a runaway batch that started unexpectedly. They request we don't evict their critical jobs; they'll try to stop it.

raj: asking Acme to restart their batch. In parallel I'll apply a soft cap to their concurrency to relieve pressure.

raj: `redwoodctl tenant update --tenant=AcmeCorp --concurrency=30 --grace_period=90s`

ops-monitor: after Acme soft cap, overall queue fell to ~1100, GPU util ~70%.

diego: recommend next steps before handoff: ask Acme to restart, monitor for rebound, schedule capacity review, consider implementing automatic tenant throttling when pool util >85%.

cs-amy: Acme says they will restart the job; ETA ~12 minutes. Sharing with affected customers.

eng-sre: note residual risk: if another large job starts we'll exhaust pool again. Follow-ups: add burst headroom, add per-tenant backpressure policy, and improve autoscaler error visibility.

ops-admin-bot: Handoff note: Next oncall @diego (shift change incoming). Summary: I-2026-1801203456; cause: reserved pool fully allocated + noisy long-lived batch; mitigations: evicted best-effort sandboxes (11), applied per-tenant throttles, route-override to dedicated-burst for impacted tenants, soft-cap on Acme; status: queue ~480, util 63%, Acme restart ETA 12m; follow-ups: capacity review ticket CP-1801203456.

diego: taking handoff. I will monitor and escalate if queue >800.

acme-eng: "We've killed the runaway process and restarted with rate-limits. Thanks for the assist. Active sessions dropped from 210 -> 16." :white_check_mark:

ops-monitor: queue now 95, GPU util 42%. Incident marked mitigated. Please monitor for 30m before closure.

cs-amy: prepping formal customer updates for SolsticeAnalytics and BrightLeaf.

eng-platform-sam: starting approval flow for temporary burst increase for next 72h; will include finance and capacity owners.

eng-sre: creating post-incident action items: runbook updates for eviction thresholds, implement auto-throttle at 85% util, add clearer autoscaler rejection alerts.

oncall-andrea: nice work everyone. I'll draft the incident timeline and follow-up tasks. :thumbsup:

-- end of thread --
